Account Executives at Klaviyo are given a tremendous opportunity to have a huge impact on Klaviyo’s prospects, on Klaviyo’s trajectory and as a result, on themselves. At Klaviyo, AEs pride themselves on being product experts who focus on closing deals the right way with the right customers whom they set up for success.

AEs at Klaviyo run the entire sales cycle from qualification to demo, driving the buying process to close with minimal air support, all while managing dozens of prospects at once. The best AEs are able to close over 70% of their opportunities, forecast their business with accuracy, and proactively manage and extract value from their territory long term.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Build Klaviyo’s client base across EMEA
  • Actively manage your pipeline and develop a strategy for long-term sustained success
  • Support the success of your peers
  • Exhibit Klaviyo’s values of accountability and effort 
  • Provide guidance and support to new Account Executives 
  • Expand your skillset by participating in adjacent tasks over time

Who You Are:

  • Minimum 1 years' experience carrying net-new revenue quota and consistent overachievement selling MarTech SaaS solutions
  • Experience selling to Founders/ Business Owners/ Marketing personas and strong knowledge of the Ecommerce/ Retailers/ Brands domain
  • Experience working in a high-velocity and high-volume sales environment, often times with multiple stakeholders
  • Experienced in and highly comfortable with outbounding and have creative techniques/ strategies
  • Fluent in English (written & verbal). 
  • Excited, motivated, and inspired by exceeding goals 
  • Aren’t afraid to hear no and embrace failure as an opportunity to improve 
  • Strong growth mindset and continually seek improvement and are rigorous in your pursuit of it 
  • Are encouraging of your team, thoughtful, engaging, and energetic 
  • Are adept at influencing and relationship building

description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role You are here to scale up data generation. Design teams can hand us 10⁶ sequences, and our automated infrastructure measures on the order of 10³ of them individually. Library construction and display is what closes that gap. We want someone who has set these systems up before and can do it again here, with their own hands. Phage, ribosome, mRNA, yeast, cell-free: which one fits depends on the library and the target, and part of the job is making that call and then building it rather than writing a recommendation. This is a build role, not a service role. For your first months you are making libraries, running selections, working out why a round collapsed, and turning what works into something the automation team can run without you. What You'll Do Build the libraries. Oligo pools, combinatorial assembly, barcoding. More campaigns fail here than at selection. Run selections end to end, including the call on whether a round enriched real binders or just fast growers. Pick the platform per campaign and stand it up. Based on the library and the target, not on what you happened to use last. Own the sequencing analysis. You don't need to be a bioinformatician, but you can't be waiting on one. Hand off to automation. A protocol that only works when you personally run it isn't finished. Close the loop. Selected designs get expressed and measured on BLI and SPR by the team next door. That tells you whether the selection worked. What We're Looking For MSc / PhD in molecular biology, protein engineering, or a relevant field, plus 3+ years running display and selection yourself. You have set up a display platform, not just used one. This is the core requirement. Built the library, got the selection working, and produced binders that held up in an independent assay. Managing outsourced CRO campaigns is not the same thing. Depth in at least one display format and working literacy across the rest. We are not fixed on which one. High-diversity cloning, and an understanding of where bias enters a pool and what it costs you later. NGS as a routine tool, and FACS if you have it. Enough Python or R to analyze your own data without joining a queue. You use AI tools seriously. It's 2026 and we run on Claude Code across the company. You also need the judgment to check what comes back. A self-starter. Nobody is going to hand you a prioritized queue. You decide what to build, build it, and tell us what you learned. Startup speed, not academic pace. Campaigns run against customer deadlines. A working platform with known limits beats an elegant one next year. You want your protocols automated rather than manual forever. If your instinct is that a campaign is finished once you have ten good clones, we will frustrate each other. We want data, not a hit list. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Type: Full time Start date: ASAP Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. We are seeking to expand our Go-To-Market team in RCTT (short for Retail, Consumer, Travel and Transportation) in Europe with a special focus on the Retail sector in the UK&I. 

Specifically, we are looking for a leader who is experienced with selling and delivering digital transformations encompassing our core offerings of Customer Experience, Product Innovation, Enterprise Platform Modernization, Data Modernization, AI Readiness, Engineering Excellence and Digital Application and Maintenance Operations (DAMO). 

You will be inheriting one large portfolio in the Retail space based on which you will grow the existing account, and acquire new accounts based on your network, your industry expertise and our marketing activities and in close collaboration with your account team, our industry and service line specialists and the RCTT market organization. 

As a Client Principals, you are responsible for the entire sales cycle (lead generation through proposal, contract negotiation and closure) as well as client relationship management, account strategy and planning, joint delivery governance and project reviews. 

This includes e.g. 

● Understand the industry context, the customer problem and define mutual value ● Develop and execute on key account plans and overall go-to-market 

● Acquire and nurture senior client relationships on strategic accounts 

● Achieve established revenue and profitability targets 

● Work closely with the account leadership team (consisting e.g. of the account tech director and account delivery director) 

● Actively participate in the go-to-market plan creation/refinement for your account as well as for the industry vertical (RCTT), and 

● Report account activity, opportunity status and other details to the RCTT leadership (portfolio director)

Job responsibilities

  •  Establish, build, and maintain long-term, value-based relationships with a growing number of senior client stakeholders.
  •  Farm and manage between one and three accounts at a time (including 1-2 prospect accounts). 
  •  Drive $20 million to $50 million in revenue per year from accounts to meet or exceed profitability targets. 
  • Ensure the creation and execution of existing account strategies, and build “win-win” value propositions at the company and individual levels. 
  • Help develop a range of IP and best practices around client and portfolio development in order to build the client base into a significant strategic asset. 
  • Approach client executives as true business partners versus software delivery partners, expanding the company’s breadth and depth to its full potential. 
  •  Work on continuous margin improvement in sold and delivered margin.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  •  A deep understanding of the retail (and ideally also the consumer goods) industry, familiarity with the main industry trends and drivers as well as relevant players (e.g. eco-system partners). 
  • A strong network in the industry. 
  •  Experience working in many different executive revenue-generating roles requiring strong business acumen. 
  • Success managing and developing sophisticated senior client relationships and strategic business partnerships across the C-suite. 
  • Experience contributing to a clients’ business using a highly consultative and solution-oriented approach. 
  • Ability to drive thought leadership and innovation experience for clients.
  • Ability to influence decisions by bringing in relevant industry trends and client stories on innovation and digital disruption. 
  • Experience in agile (custom) software development project delivery with the ability to understand the momentum of technical projects and the challenges a highly technical team will face in project execution.

Professional Skills

  •  A strategic thinker, with the ability to translate concepts and ideas into practical and tactical action and the skills to create value propositions for clients. 
  •  A goal-oriented self-starter, with strong consultative instincts and skills who quickly and easily establishes rapport and credibility. 
  • Comfortable seeking out and interfacing with external constituents, and has the personal and social attributes to create and then manage effective long-lasting relationships.
  •  Skilled at negotiation and working in an ecosystem with external partners.
  •  Must be able to craft visions and adopt progressive points of view regarding the future, and rally people around the agendas that drive change. 
  • Thinks strategically, but also is highly skilled at execution in a complex environment with multiple stakeholders. 
  • A leader who inspires and grows a team who understands what it means to “put the team over self” .
  •  The ability to lead and motivate account and software development teams with creativity,imagination, energy, and enthusiasm.

Projects are almost exclusively on customer site, so candidates should be flexible and open to travel.

description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role You'll be the person who makes sure Adaptyv shows up well in public, every day. That means managing our social presence across X and LinkedIn, running the Proteinbase community, owning the participant side of our open competitions and hackathons, and triaging inbound community and customer messages. Whatever it takes to keep our community-facing surface area healthy as we grow. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll be the go-to person for anything community: content, social, events, and the day-to-day rhythm of how Adaptyv talks to the outside world. You'll work closely with the founders and the science team, and you'll have a direct impact on how the protein design and AI bio communities experience us. Responsibilities Manage Adaptyv's day-to-day social presence on X and LinkedIn: product updates, customer wins, blog amplifications, conference content, and reactive posts on what's happening in the field. Run the Proteinbase community day-to-day: newsletter, competition updates, designer spotlights, and the Slack where participants and contributors gather. Own the participant-facing side of our open competitions and hackathons, from applicant communication and rules through to judging logistics and post-event recaps. Turn each event into a public artifact (leaderboard, dataset, blog post). Triage inbound community and customer messages, routing deeper technical questions to the right person on the team. Coordinate with the founders and the science team on what to post, what to amplify, and what to hold. What we're looking for 1-3 years running social, content, or community for a technical company, a science-adjacent media brand, an event series, or a community platform. Self-built audiences and adjacent experience count equally. A strong, distinctive writing voice. You move between LinkedIn announcements, customer replies, and community posts without defaulting to generic AI phrasing. Genuine curiosity about biology and AI. No science degree required, but you should be able to follow technical conversations in protein design and AI without needing them explained. Highly organized. You'll juggle multiple channels, partnerships, and ongoing threads simultaneously, and build the systems to track them. Comfortable with ambiguity. There is no editorial calendar or playbook. You'll decide what's worth posting based on what we're shipping and what the field is discussing. Bonus: existing presence in protein design or AI bio circles, prior experience running a hackathon or competition, short-form video editing, or a track record of building a technical community from scratch. Location: On-site or remote, with timezone overlap with US or Europe. Occasional travel to Lausanne and to events. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role As our Dutch speaking Customer Success Manager at Rentman, you’ll do more than answer questions or solve issues. You’re the strategic partner who helps our customers get the most value out of our platform and transform the way they run their business. You’ll work with rental companies and event professionals who rely on Rentman to manage fast-paced operations, guiding them through onboarding, adoption, and everyday use. Your mission: help them unlock the full potential of our platform so they can deliver flawless events, scale efficiently and stay ahead of the competition. Your goal is to help customers succeed with Rentman, ensuring they can deliver events smoothly, scale efficiently and get the results they’re aiming for. You’ll also collaborate closely with Sales, Product and Support contributing to strategic conversations that influence both customer outcomes and the future of our platform. What you'll do Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with your customer portfolio through regular check-ins and proactive guidance. Understand customer goals, usage patterns, and challenges through customer interactions and Vitally data, in order to drive customer health, product adoption and identify expansion and upsell opportunities. Be the voice of your market by sharing recurring feedback with Product, influencing our roadmap and making sure our platform stays ahead of industry needs. Lead impactful customer consultation sessions that empower users to make the most of Rentman, driving customer health, product adoption and advocacy. Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing and Support to ensure smooth handovers and an aligned customer experience. What we are looking for 2+ years’ experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, or Implementation – ideally in a B2B or SaaS environment within the AV or Event Rental industry. Fluent in Dutch and in English, with the ability to engage confidently with both customers and colleagues across diverse backgrounds. Having a strategic mindset, being able to link product capabilities to business objectives and uncover opportunities for greater impact. An excellent communicator who can break down complex topics into clear, actionable steps for users of all technical levels and at turning data into meaningful insights. Structured and detail-oriented, able to manage your portfolio of customers and keep track of timelines, technical requirements and tasks. Proactive and accountable, taking full ownership of your market and customer base while turning challenges into opportunities. Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional settings. A personality that thrives at Rentman – strong ownership, collaborative spirit, curiosity and a drive to solve complex problems together. Nice to haves Additional language like German, French, Spanish (C1 level). Cloud product know-how. What you’ll get Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary) 25 vacation days to recharge Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years. A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year Pension plan through BrightPensioen An annual training budget to grow your skills Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17 Our process Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea: Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30-45 mins) Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins) Take-home assignment (max 120 mins) Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins) Apply now! description: TL;DR - Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Als Marktführer in der Kieferorthopädie und mit einer großen Finanzierungsrunde im Rücken skalieren wir nun in andere medizinische Fachbereiche - und du bist an vorderster Front dabei. Als Customer Success Manager setzt du neue Standards für moderne Kundenbetreuung und -entwicklung und übernimmst die End-to-End Betreuung unserer Kunden und hilfst dabei, Kunden pro-aktiv zum Erfolg mit unserem Produkt zu führen. Wieso praxipal? Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzen wird. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir wachsen in Rekordgeschwindigkeit und haben vor kurzem eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde in Höhe von $6.7 Millionen mit HV Capital abgeschlossen - und wir fangen gerade erst an. Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten – aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. description:
La Data Value Chain recrute !

 

REJOINS L'ÉQUIPE DATA DOWNSTREAM INVENTORY MANAGEMENT

Au sein de l'équipe Downstream Inventory Management, nous jouons un rôle crucial pour la supply chain de Decathlon. Notre objectif est d'identifier le niveau de stock optimale de plusieurs dizaines de millions de couples article/magasin chaque jour. 

Ces cibles de stock permettent le réapprovisionnement de plus de 2000 magasins dans le monde. Notre objectif est double : assurer la satisfaction client en ayant le bon produit au bon endroit, tout en minimisant notre empreinte carbone en évitant la surproduction, le surstockage et le transport inutile.

 

Data Analyst Inventory (STAGE)

Nous recrutons un.e Data Analyst en stage, basé.e à Lille.

TES MISSIONS

  • Tu compareras les méthodes de réapprovisionnement traditionnelles (formules analytiques min-max, ABC/XYZ) et les approches Data/ML (prévision quantilique, optimisation multi-échelon).
  • Tu développeras des analyses de données pour aider la supply chain de Decathlon à prendre de meilleures décisions.
  • Tu mèneras une étude complète de la qualité de l'inventory management des magasins Decathlon.
  • Tu contribueras  à l'implémentation de la nouvelle solution proposée.
  • Tu participeras à la vie d'une équipe agile composée de Data Analysts,Analytics Engineers (l'équipe est jeune, sportive et basée entre Paris et Lille !).

TON ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE

  • Langages : SQL, Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn)
  • Outils BI : Tableau
  • Data Engineering : dbt, Databricks, Spark
  • Plateformes Cloud : AWS, GCP
  • Versioning & DevOps : Git, CI/CD, VSCode 

CE DONT TU AS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

🚀 Un environnement de travail stimulant : entreprise certifiée Great Place to Work et Happy Trainees.

  • Remboursement de 50% du titre de transport & aide à la mobilité urbaine
    🎯 Un accompagnement sur mesure : coaching, formations internes et externes, partage de connaissances.
    ⚡ Une culture du sport et du test produit : deviens ambassadeur.trice de nos innovations et rejoins nos équipes sportives internes !

FAQ – TOUTES TES QUESTIONS

Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. description:
Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI


Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI · Director level · London preferred

We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.

 Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.

 

Main focus and responsibilities:

Commercial and solutioning

  • Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.
  • Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.
  • Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.
  • You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.

Practice leadership

  • Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.
  • Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.
  • Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.

Client engagement

  • Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.
  • Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.
  • Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.
  • Expected to lead and drive P&L with TCV of 50 -75 M GBP and ACV of 45-50 M GBP/
  • Expected experience and capabilities in driving all P&L criterias including sales, margin, utilization, bench management, training, learning, partnership based sales etc.

 

Ideal candidate profile

The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.


Criterion

Requirement

Experience

Significant senior experience in data and AI consulting, typically 15+ years, with a track record in leadership roles. You are neither a pure solution architect nor a pure sales profile.

Commercial track record

History of selling multiple large-scale data and AI deals, ideally including recent GenAI or agentic engagements, and able to discuss deal shape, pricing structure, trade-offs and delivery and business value delivery in concrete terms.

Technical expertise

Strong solutioning background in complex ecosystems: data platforms and data products, data governance, and AI systems in production, including agentic and LLM-based systems. You understand failure modes, evaluation, cost and risk, not just architecture diagrams.

Data/AI balance

Roughly 70/30, with demonstrable recent depth in AI (last 2–4 years), for example AI agents, AI advisory or AI foundations with large UK clients. Data depth is the foundation, but hand on AI credibility is required.

Tech stack

Strong cloud proficiency in at least one major platform (GCP, AWS or Azure). Snowflake or Databricks experience is a strong plus. Familiarity with the AI tooling and model platforms available on those clouds is expected. Experience on NVIDIA and other modern tech stacks will be great addition.

Commercial acumen

Comfortable with P&L, business cases and ROI conversations, and able to negotiate with CFO-level stakeholders.

Leadership

Experience leading and scaling teams of this size, in a matrix, through change.


Location and travel
  • UK-wide remit. London-based candidates (or within about a two-hour commute) are preferred, with 1–2 days a week in the London office for collaboration and leadership visibility. 
  • Weekly once or twice travel to customer location in UKI. 

Soft skills and cultural fit

  • You bring drive and resilience, and you build momentum in a fast-changing environment.
  • Executive presence: exceptional communication, with real C-level exposure and comfort presenting and negotiating with CDOs and CXOs.
  • Facilitation of strategic workshops and consultative client conversations.
  • Comfort leading through ambiguity while the delivery model and competency frameworks are still maturing.
  • A coaching mindset: you grow other leaders and raise AI fluency across the team.

Learning & Development

  • There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. 
  • But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. 
  • This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. 
  • We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

  • At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.
  • Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.
  • We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

  • Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we're pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. 
  • For 30+ years, we've delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. 
  • Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary.

description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful. This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one. What You'll Do Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks. Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically. Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review. Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other. Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models. Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs. What We're Looking For Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end. Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind. Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call. Prolific builder with the receipts to prove it. You've shipped a lot — pipelines, tools, models, datasets — and can point to concrete things you built end to end and put into real use, not prototypes that died in a notebook. You move fast, systematize what works, and have no patience for babysitting a fixed dashboard. AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce. Interdisciplinary by instinct. You're energized working across the lab bench, software, and ML, and you treat automation and data infrastructure as part of your job. Bonus: experience with protein/sequence-structure data (bioinformatics tooling, structural data), ML on experimental data, or building datasets for model training and benchmarking. We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire.

A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck.   • A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable.

Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap.
  • An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way.

How we'll measure success

The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results.

Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake.

What we're looking for

  • You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work.

  • You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders.

Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more.

Why Telnyx

This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth.

Equal opportunity

Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen. Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos. AI-First denken: KI und Automatisierung produktiv in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service bringen. description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We are building the most automated lab in the world, and that does not stop at the bench. A company that AI agents can run experiments in has to automate everything around the experiment too — procurement, hiring, admin, and finance. Finance is one of the most automatable functions in any company and almost nobody has actually done it. We intend to. That is the job: build an AI-powered finance stack. Our ledger, billing, cards and payroll all expose APIs, and we already close the books against them programmatically rather than by hand. You would take that much further, to where the model, the close, the cash view and the margin analysis largely run themselves, and your week goes on the decisions instead of the reconciliation. You would be our first finance hire, and it is hands-on. You will build the forecast, run the close across two entities, own cash, and be the person who can say what a protein actually costs us to make. What You'll Do Own the forecast. Both directions: bottom-up from lab capacity, throughput and price per protein, and top-down P&L, burn and runway. Own gross margin. What does an experiment actually cost us — DNA, reagents, consumables, instrument time, labour? Which products and which customers lose us money? Own pricing, with commercial. What we charge, why, and where the floor is. Pricing at a lab company is a finance question wearing a sales hat. Own the close. Group consolidation and intercompany management. Make it fast, make it correct, make it boring. Own cash. Bank and card accounts across Switzerland and the US, AP runs, AR collection, payment timing. Know where the money is and where it is going before anyone asks. Keep us compliant. Tax, VAT, audit, payroll, and the external firms we work with. You are not a lawyer or an accountant, but you know when to call one. Investor reporting, fundraising support, and treasury management. Equipment leasing and asset management. The lab runs on millions of francs of instruments. Lease or buy, how we finance it, what it does to the balance sheet, and keeping the asset register honest as we expand. Automate all of the above. What We're Looking For You have built a finance function, not just worked in one. Several years in finance at a startup that actually scaled, and ideally you were early enough to have set things up rather than inherited them. You can build a real model. Not a template. A model that ties operational reality — throughput, yield, capacity, headcount — to cash, and that survives someone pulling on it. You write code, or you are visibly about to. SQL at minimum, Python ideally. This is the hard requirement most finance candidates will fail, and we mean it. We run on Claude Code across the company, and every system finance touches has an API behind it. The best version of this person automates their own function, writes their own tooling, and finds leverage the rest of us have not thought of. If your instinct is that finance is a spreadsheet-and-portal job, we will frustrate each other. You understand the cost structure of a physical business. Reagents, instruments, consumables, capex versus COGS, yield loss. Lab, hardware, or manufacturing backgrounds all translate. Pure SaaS finance does not, on its own. Swiss and European finance experience. VAT, social charges, employment law. A US entity alongside a Swiss one is a plus. Ambitious, and in it for the company. We want someone who intends to be running finance at a much larger Adaptyv in three years, and who cares about what we are building rather than the title on the door. Trustworthy with everything. Salaries, revenue, investor communications, board material. All of it crosses your desk. Scope We are a small company and nobody here has clean edges around their job. You will end up in the lab, in a room with a customer, and every so often doing something that is nobody's job simply because it needs doing. The centre of gravity is the numbers: the model, the close, cash, margin, pricing, and the board pack. That is the part that is yours and the part we will judge the role on. description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role This is an internship for an exceptional molecular biologist who wants to do the most serious work of their life so far. Take a workflow that's flaky or slow and make it reliable and faster — better protocols, better automation, fewer failures. Work hands-on with liquid handlers and lab automation, and help push manual protocols toward automated ones. Bring rigor to your data: document precisely, track samples, and make your results reproducible and traceable. Diagnose failures across biology, reagents, and instruments — and fix them, not just flag them. What We're Looking For Strong hands already. You've done real molecular biology — PCR, cloning, transformation, electrophoresis, ideally protein expression and purification — through research, a project, or a prior internship, and you're good at it. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting for someone to hand you the next step. AI-native. It's 2026 — you use AI tools as a default to learn faster and work smarter. High standards and high drive. You care that the experiment is right, you move fast, and you're excited that the robots run real customer experiments. You will be the technical leader and lead architect for one of Databricks' most strategic global customers: a health technology company whose diagnostic, therapy, connected-care and consumer health products reach hundreds of millions of people every year. The Impact You Will Have

Own and drive the technical vision

  • Scale GenAI and agentic AI from pilot to production across business units.
  • Build partner ecosystem relationships (GSIs, ISVs, hyperscalers) to scale delivery.
  • Create reusable IP (reference designs, accelerators, talks, blogs) for the wider Databricks health and life sciences community.

What We Look For

(Note: it is not expected that you “tick every box” below and encourage you to apply if you are meeting several of the key criteria and can demonstrate a strong ability to transfer skills and develop quickly in the role!)  

  • Proven record as lead technical figure on a large global enterprise account, or as enterprise/chief architect at a similar organisation, owning the vision over multiple years.

Technical depth

  • 10+ years in data engineering, analytics, ML or AI architecture, with significant customer-facing technical leadership (pre-sales, consulting or enterprise architecture).
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in modern data and AI platforms; Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Databricks experience is a strong plus.
  • Experience designing:
    • Large-scale data platforms and migrations from legacy warehouses, Hadoop or other clouds
    • Enterprise governance and security models

  • Proven ability to win platform decisions against hyperscaler-native and competing platforms on architecture, cost and governance.
  • Proficient in Python and SQL; able to prototype quickly, including with AI-assisted development.

Domain knowledge

  • Experience in health technology, medical devices, life sciences or another regulated industry, and a passion for improving patient outcomes with Data + AI.
  • Working knowledge of MedTech and medical AI regulation:
    • EU MDR/IVDR
    • FDA SaMD and Predetermined Change Control Plans
    • ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and ISO 14971
    • EU AI Act requirements for high-risk medical AI
  • Understanding of privacy and data-sharing regimes (GDPR, HIPAA, European Health Data Space). Familiarity with healthcare data standards (DICOM, HL7, FHIR, OMOP).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with or at a global MedTech, health technology or diagnostics company.
  • Experience designing validated, audit-ready (GxP / 21 CFR Part 11) data and AI environments. Enterprise-scale SAP data integration (BW, S/4HANA) and semantic harmonisation.
  • Public thought leadership: conference talks, publications or open source.
  • Dutch is a plus; professional English required.

description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

About the Team

The Physical AI team at CoreWeave is building the compute foundation for the next era of AI. We focus on one of the highest-conviction bets in the company: enabling autonomous vehicle developers to train, simulate and validate intelligent driving systems at scale. Our team connects CoreWeave's specialised AI cloud with the software workflows that power autonomous driving development, from processing fleet and sensor data to running complex simulations and training advanced AI models. We operate where the demands of autonomy push conventional cloud architectures to their limits.

As the Principal Architect for Autonomous Vehicles, you will have founding-team-level influence and own the overarching product and technical strategy for CoreWeave's autonomous vehicle offering. You will shape the roadmap across data processing, distributed training, simulation and validation, working alongside product, research, engineering and commercial stakeholders.

This hands-on technical leadership role spans the full stack, from bare-metal GPU/CPU topologies, networking and storage through workload orchestration to application-facing APIs and autonomous driving software ecosystems, including NVIDIA's. You will define how fleet data, sensor simulation, synthetic data generation and closed-loop evaluation fit together into reproducible workflows, balancing simulation fidelity, throughput, reliability and cost.

You will partner directly with automotive manufacturers, suppliers and autonomous vehicle developers to understand their requirements, identify capability gaps and translate platform capabilities into deployed solutions. You will guide strategic customer engagements, establish reference architectures and help turn technical advances into customer adoption and commercial growth.

Qualifications:

  • Proven track record of founding, leading or architecting autonomous vehicle platforms, simulation systems or AI infrastructure that reached production or commercial deployment.
  • Deep understanding of autonomous driving workflows, including perception, prediction and planning, and how data, model training, simulation and evaluation support their development.
  • Hands-on experience building distributed systems under demanding throughput, latency, reliability and scale requirements.
  • Experience designing GPU-based training or simulation platforms, with a strong understanding of compute, networking, storage and workload orchestration.
  • Familiarity with fleet data pipelines, sensor simulation, scenario generation and closed-loop testing, including reproducibility and coverage of rare or difficult driving conditions.
  • Ability to identify where existing architectures limit customer outcomes, define practical alternatives and build alignment across engineering, research and product teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect system architecture with product strategy and business development, working directly with technical leaders and enterprise customers.

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You love taking complex autonomy and AI infrastructure challenges from initial architectural design through to commercially successful deployment.
  • You're curious about how advances in simulation, synthetic data and AI models can accelerate the development and validation of autonomous vehicles.
  • You enjoy working directly with customers and bringing engineering, research and commercial teams together around a clear technical direction.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is £146,000 to £195,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role Our lab produces binding data faster than any one person can look at it. Runs come off the Gators and the Carterra, go through our processing pipeline, and land in a review queue. Somebody with real judgment then has to decide: is this curve real? Is that a fit artifact or a genuine two-state binding event? Does this replicate get delivered, or does the sample get re-run? That person is you. The second half of the job is talking to the customer about it. When a design team gets a plate back and three of their best predictions look like non-binders, they want to talk to someone who can explain why: reference subtraction, avidity, an off-rate at the edge of what the instrument resolves, or simply a bad protein. You'll be that person, on the call, sharing your screen, walking through sensorgrams. This is a role for a scientist who is very good at kinetics and also likes people. If you like one but not the other, you'll be unhappy here. What You'll Do Review the binding data coming out of the lab. Every SPR and BLI run passes through our processing pipeline and then to human review, and you're the expert eye on the output. You decide what gets delivered, what gets flagged, and what gets re-run. Judge the curves, not just the numbers. A clean-looking Kd on a bad fit is worse than no number at all. You know the difference between a real off-rate and a drifting baseline, and you can say why. Review data from our other assays too: thermostability, expression, developability, enzyme activity. Binding is the core of the role but it isn't all of it. Talk to customers about their results. Deliverable walkthroughs, follow-up questions, and the awkward conversation when the data doesn't say what they hoped. You explain what we measured, how confident we are, and what to do next. Turn review into experimental design. When something needs a re-run, you decide what changes: orientation, regeneration, concentration series, or a switch from BLI to SPR for the sensitivity. Analyze at the batch level, not just the sample level. With hundreds of results per experiment, you should be writing a script to find the pattern rather than clicking through a queue. Systematic drift, a bad reference channel, or a target lot behaving differently than the last one shows up in aggregate long before it shows up in any single curve. Feed what you learn back into the pipeline. When you catch a case where automation passed something it shouldn't have, or failed something it shouldn't have, that becomes a concrete requirement for the software team. Work closely with production (what actually happened in the lab), QC (systematic quality), and customer success (the relationship around the science). What We're Looking For MSc / PhD in biochemistry, biophysics, or a relevant field, plus 3+ years working hands-on with binding kinetics. Deep SPR and BLI experience. Biacore, Carterra, Octet, Gator: the platform matters less than the fact that you've run these assays, troubleshot them, and interpreted a lot of data from them. You've seen enough sensorgrams to know immediately when one is lying to you. Real fitting judgment. 1:1 vs. bivalent, when steady-state is appropriate and when it isn't, how mass transport and avidity distort a result. You can defend a Kd, or refuse to report one. Strong data analysis skills. Python or R, enough to pull a few hundred results out of a database, fit them, plot them, and find the outliers. This role generates too much data to review by hand. You use AI tools seriously. We run on Claude Code and similar tooling internally, and the people who get the most done here are the ones who reach for it by default: writing the analysis script, querying the database, building the one-off dashboard. You don't need to have done this before, but you need to want to. If your instinct is that real scientists do it by hand, this isn't the place. A self-starter who works independently. Nobody is going to hand you a prioritized queue every morning. You'll figure out what matters most, go do it, and tell us what you found. A fast learner. Our platform, our assays, and our software change constantly. You'll be handed unfamiliar tools and expected to be productive with them quickly. Startup speed, not academic pace. Experiments ship to paying customers on deadlines. Getting a good answer this week beats a perfect one next quarter, and we'd rather flag an ambiguous result than sit on it. Comfortable in front of customers. Many are PhD-level scientists at pharma companies and AI labs, and they will push back. You should enjoy that conversation rather than dread it. Able to explain hard things simply. Some customers are biophysicists. Some are ML researchers who have never touched a pipette. You adjust without condescending to either. Honest about uncertainty. When the data is ambiguous, you say so, to us and to the customer. We would much rather flag a weak result than ship a confident wrong one. Familiarity with other biophysical or functional assays (DSF, HPLC, plate-based activity assays) is a plus. description: Our mission and why it matters We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer. Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations. We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them. Why this role matters The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area. What you’ll own and drive You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps. What success looks like • In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps. • By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota. What makes you thrive here You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude. You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor. To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region. Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow. Who you’ll work with You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide. What you can expect from us • Compensation: Monthly fixed base salary of € 6000 - € 7000 depending on your experience (plus a 50/50 base and commission model featuring accelerated earnings for the first 12 months). However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team. • High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety. • Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on. • A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth. • The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany. To ensure your personal data is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR, we only accept applications submitted through our application form. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc. As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. description: Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen. Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen. Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer. Wat je gaat doen Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare. Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening: advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen. Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg. Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere: · Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op; · Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie; · Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel; · Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden; · Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen; · Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam; · Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde. Wie jij bent Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? · Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort; · Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering; · Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij; · Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego; · Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT; · Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg; · Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur; · Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; · Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op: · Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring; · Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon; · Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren; · Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers; · Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk; · Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren; · Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties; · Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt; · Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen; · Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team. Over Beter Healthcare Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt. Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil. Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices. Voel jij een “ja”?
