description:
Who We Are

MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses.

About WPP

MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

Do you have strong data and analytical skills, with a passion for shaping business strategy? Can you architect, build, and apply modern data models to deliver impactful marketing insights? Are you seeking an exciting role with significant opportunities for leadership and growth? Then you might be the Senior Data Insights Consultant we are looking for! 

What will your day look like?

As our new Senior Data Insights Consultant, you will join our growing Technology and Data team. Here, you will be a key leader in helping our clients make data-driven decisions to enhance their digital communication on an enterprise scale. This entails designing, enabling, and delivering complex data solutions and integrations for various campaign platforms. More specifically, your tasks will include: 

  • Architecting, building, and delivering value-adding insights solutions, serving as a key advisor to clients on how to leverage their data assets to optimize large-scale communication strategies. 
  • Performing advanced analysis to uncover actionable patterns, trends, and opportunities that directly inform client strategy and decision-making. 
  • Designing and running test-and-learn programs (A/B tests, incrementality, holdouts) across channels to measure impact and continuously optimize communication performance. 
  • Partnering with senior stakeholders to define strategic business questions and translating them into robust analytical frameworks and data roadmaps. 
  • Supporting or leading the data-stream on complex, large-scale projects with globally recognised brands, ensuring that data solutions and integrations are designed and delivered for scalability and business impact. 
  • Driving ongoing proactive client ideation — identifying new opportunities, use cases, and data-driven initiatives that help clients grow their business. 
  • Helping drive agentic AI adoption, exploring and embedding agentic solutions into our data and insights workflows to enhance efficiency and client value. 
  • Providing answers and insights to business-related questions via automated reporting solutions as well as ad-hoc data analyses, including building reports and insights dashboards within marketing platforms such as Adobe and Salesforce. 
  • Mentoring, reviewing, and advising less senior team members — elevating quality, fostering technical excellence, and supporting their professional growth. 
  • Collaborating with highly skilled specialists including Account Managers, Architects, Developers, Creatives, Strategists, Data Scientists and Marketing Operations experts to service our clients coherently. 

Who are you going to work with?

You will join a team of hands-on Data Insights Consultants, Data Scientists and Data Engineers who are passionate about bringing value and knowledge from data. We are all about unlocking insights from data through analytics and making that insight applicable in 1:1 data-driven communication and CRM. Your work will always be firmly anchored in data in a cross-disciplinary setting, collaborating closely with highly enthusiastic experts from Strategy or Creative backgrounds. 

What do you bring to the table?

As a person, you possess a strong consultancy mindset, demonstrating resilience, curiosity, and an eager-to-learn attitude. You combine this with strong business acumen, allowing you to understand and anticipate client needs effectively. You are outgoing and love being part of interdisciplinary projects and solutions. You are eager to learn and quick to understand the complexity of high-tech dialogues and solutions. 

Furthermore, you have the drive, enthusiasm, and technical credibility to act as the primary data and insights advisor for senior client leadership, guiding them through complex challenges and inspiring them to grow their business. It's an advantage if you have consulting, agency experience or marketing domain knowledge, but it's not a requirement. 

In addition, you have: 

Technical skills 

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in a consultant/business liaison role related to data, BI, analytics or reporting solutions. Can independently design, build, and optimize modern analytics solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real-world production use. 
  • Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries, ensuring clarity, efficiency, and production readiness. 
  • Design and build scalable dimensional data models from raw source systems (fact/dimension structures, performance-aware design). Apply strong data modelling principles, governance standards and practices that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security. 
  • Develop and manage DBT transformations using layered architecture, including testing and documentation best practices. 
  • Build production-ready Power BI semantic models and dashboards, including advanced DAX measures, performance optimization, and secure data access (RLS). 
  • Work collaboratively using GitHub, following structured branching, pull request, and code review workflows. 
  • Familiarity with or a strong interest in the application of AI and agentic frameworks, and machine learning principles to generate conversational analytics, predictive and advanced marketing insights. 
  • Comfortable working in modern cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Fabric). 
  • Understanding the data structures and reporting capabilities within major marketing and martech platforms (e.g., Adobe Campaign/AJO, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Ability to build and deliver reports and insights dashboards natively within these tools is a strong advantage 

Interpersonal skills 

  • A proven ability to build trust and act as a strategic partner to senior-level clients and internal leaders. You can confidently navigate complex, technical stakeholder environments and influence decision-making through data-driven reasoning. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex data concepts and insights into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and senior business audiences. 
  • The ability to critically assess complex business challenges, ask probing questions to uncover root causes, and propose robust, data-driven solutions. 
  • Proven experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members. You actively foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 
  • You are a self-starter who can think critically, identify issues and opportunities autonomously, and take the initiative to propose and implement corrective actions. 

A leader in personalized customer experiences

WPP Enterprise Solutions MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper-personalisation at scale, marketing automation, and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency, and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands (including Ford, Jaguar Land Rover, Nespresso, IKEA, Lego, and Coca-Cola) to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1,000+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.

A global network

We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. 

#LI-EMEA

description: MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie. Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie. Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering. Financial Control Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen. Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces. Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages. Business Control & Business Partnering Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning. Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses. Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie. Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning. Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's. description:
About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team

Strategic Finance is part of Alma's Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma's economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products.

We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma's P&L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached.

About the job

  • Own your piece of the P&L. Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.
  • Run the key finance processes of your scope. Depending on the scope: pricing, merchant performance reviews, cost and margin analysis, country reviews. You are accountable for their quality, and for making them better at every cycle.
  • Be a real partner to the business. Work day to day with the commercial, product and operations teams, step back from the numbers, and bring a clear recommendation whenever a decision is on the table.
  • Rebuild how finance works with AI. Prototype AI-assisted workflows, industrialise the ones that work, and free up the team's time for analysis and influence. Raising the bar on how we work matters as much as what we deliver.

You will work with

Google Sheets · Excel · SQL (largely AI-assisted) · Notion · Slack · AI assistants and LLMs

 About you

To succeed in this job

  • Have 6 to 7 years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, transaction services, consulting or a similar analytical role, ideally including time in a fast-growing company.
  • Model with ease and think in unit economics: you can build a business plan from raw data and spot when a number doesn't make sense. Querying is largely AI-assisted at Alma, so data judgement matters more than deep SQL.
  • Have a strong appetite for AI and learn fast. Ideally, you have already built AI-assisted workflows and made them stick.
  • Take ownership and bring business sense: you make a scope your own, you know when to step back, and you can influence people who don't report to you. You work comfortably in English and have enough French for day-to-day exchanges with colleagues (native French is not required).

And it will be nice if you also

  • Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Have exposure to fintech, payments or BNPL.
  • Speak a third language beyond French and English, a real plus given our European footprint.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Ownership and visibility. A piece of Alma's P&L that is truly yours, with direct exposure.
  • AI at the core of the job. The chance to redesign how a finance team works, building the workflows rather than just using them.

  • Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

Interview Process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.
  • Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.
  • Case study presentation with 2 - 3 team members (ideally in house) to assess your practical knowledge.

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. The Internship Programme at Graphcore

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.

What you’ll work on

Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware. 

In AI Compute Libraries & Performance, you’ll contribute to C++ libraries and compute kernels for machine learning workloads. Your work will include: 

  • Developing compute kernels: Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations. 
  • Understanding and improving performance: Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance. 
  • Checking correctness and reliability: Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use. 

Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable. 

Your team and support

You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.

You’ll contribute to clearly scoped projects and build your skills with guidance from engineers working in performance and low-level software. Together, we use profiling, experiments and technical reviews to compare approaches, understand trade-offs and improve our solutions. 

Your buddy will help you settle in, get familiar with our tools and ways of working, and find the right people to ask. Your manager will meet with you regularly to agree goals, offer feedback and discuss your development, including time for learning. 

We welcome different perspectives and make space for everyone to contribute. Questions, alternative approaches and requests for help are part of how we work. As you take on more responsibility, your colleagues will help you work through challenges, and your ideas will be listened to and discussed respectfully. 

How you’ll learn and grow

Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build performance engineering skills through hands-on work on compute kernels, benchmarks and tests. 

Profiling and experiments will help you understand where time is spent and how changes to code and data layout affect performance. Numerical validation and regression testing will show you how to check that an optimisation preserves correct results and continues to work as software changes. 

Working with specialists and discussing technical trade-offs will help you develop your engineering judgement, explain your findings and connect mathematical operations to efficient implementations on hardware.

What we're looking for

  • Currently studying towards a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field
  • Experience with C or C++11, plus familiarity with Python or scripting tools for automation and testing
  • An understanding of linear algebra, numerical methods or scientific computing
  • Problem-solving skills and collaborative approach to unfamiliar technical challenges

Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through coursework, personal or team projects or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned.

Coursework or experience with machine learning frameworks, parallel programming, code optimisation, maths libraries or performance analysis would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work
  • 5 days of annual leave: Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship
  • Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista
  • Learning and development: Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.

Introduction to Graphcore

At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier.
Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together.

How to apply and what to expect 

To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring.

Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over veiligheidstrainingen: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. Je geeft zelf richting aan de werkzaamheden door verantwoordelijkheid te laten zien. Jij bepaalt, samen met je begeleider hoe jouw stageperiode eruit komt te zien. Analyseren van risico’s en helpen bij het opstellen van veiligheidsplannen. Actief meedoen aan toolbox meetings en veiligheidstrainingen. Assisteren bij incidentonderzoeken en meewerken aan verbeterplannen. Ondersteunen bij het implementeren van veiligheidsmaatregelen en -systemen. Dit is jouw team Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Neem dan eens een kijkje op onze website. Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Dit breng je mee Je doet een hbo-studie in de richting van Integrale Veiligheidskunde (of vergelijkbaar); Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector; Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken; Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden; Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week. Ben jij enthousiast over een stage bij Dura Vermeer? Solliciteer dan snel! Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. description: À propos de nous Chez Upvest, notre mission est de rendre l’investissement aussi simple que dépenser de l’argent. Upvest permet aux entreprises de proposer une large gamme de produits d’investissement et la meilleure expérience en matière d’investissement sur les marchés de capitaux et d’épargne retraite. Notre Investment API s’intègre facilement, pour que les fintechs et les institutions financières puissent se concentrer pleinement sur leur cœur de métier. Nous travaillons avec les principales fintechs et institutions financières européennes, comme DKB, Revolut, N26 et Raisin. Fondée en 2017 par Martin Kassing, Upvest réunit aujourd’hui plus de 270 professionnels de plus de 70 nationalités. Upvest a levé 280 M€ auprès d’investisseurs de premier plan, dont BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital et Motive. Notre dernier tour de table de 105 M€, en mars 2026 et mené par Sapphire et Tencent, accélère notre croissance et nous permet d’offrir une expérience d’investissement haut de gamme. Le poste En 2027, Upvest lance le Plan d’Épargne en Actions (PEA) sur le marché français avec plusieurs fintechs de premier plan. Au sein de l’équipe Settlements & Transfers, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne post-marché des transferts de comptes-titres et de PEA : du traitement des instructions au dénouement chez Euroclear France, en passant par les relations avec les teneurs de compte, les dépositaires et les émetteurs. Ce stage vous offre une exposition directe au post-marché français et européen dans une phase de lancement, avec de réelles responsabilités dès les premières semaines. Vos missions Transferts entrants et sortants : Prendre en charge les transferts de comptes-titres (CTO) et de PEA avec les banques et courtiers en France et en Europe, de la réception de la demande jusqu’au dénouement des titres et des espèces. Relations contreparties et clients : Assurer une communication fluide avec les contreparties (banques, courtiers, dépositaires) et nos clients, et piloter le suivi des demandes et des relances. Contrôles et réconciliations : Vérifier les positions titres et espèces, rapprocher les mouvements avec notre dépositaire et analyser les écarts. Gestion des suspens et des anomalies : Analyser les instructions non dénouées ou rejetées, en identifier l’origine et coordonner leur résolution avec les contreparties et les équipes internes. Fiscalité du PEA : Contrôler et intégrer les bordereaux d’information (BI) afin de garantir la continuité de l’historique fiscal du plan. Titres au nominatif : Traiter les opérations sur titres nominatifs (conversions, inscriptions, radiations). Reporting et amélioration continue : Suivre activement les SLA et les KPI, rédiger les procédures et identifier des pistes d’automatisation. Votre profil Formation : Master 1 ou 2 en finance, banque, économie ou droit (école de commerce, d’ingénieurs ou université), en année de césure ou jeune diplômé(e) d’un Master, avec possibilité de signer une convention de stage. Pour les M1 : votre établissement doit permettre un stage de 6 mois à temps plein (semestre intégré ou dispense de cours). Langues : Français langue maternelle (indispensable) et anglais courant. Expérience : Une première expérience en banque, back-office, middle-office ou opérations titres est un réel atout, tout comme une connaissance du PEA, du post-marché ou d’Euroclear France. Motivation : Un véritable intérêt pour les marchés de capitaux et les opérations post-marché. Esprit d’analyse : Rigueur, sens du détail et goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes. Outils : Bonne maîtrise d’Excel / Google Sheets ; la connaissance de SQL/Python est un plus. Pourquoi nous rejoindre Un travail à fort impact : Nous construisons l’infrastructure qui portera l’avenir de l’investissement en Europe. C’est complexe, ambitieux et porteur de sens. Vous travaillerez avec des technologies modernes et créerez quelque chose de totalement nouveau, sans système hérité et sans limites. Moments d’équipe : Participez aux événements d’entreprise comme UpFest, les dîners, les offsites et la fête de fin d’année, pour échanger avec vos collègues et célébrer nos réussites. Inclusion : Nous nous engageons pour une culture où chacun a sa place et s’épanouit. Nos groupes de ressources pour les employés favorisent l’inclusion et les liens, comme Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out et UpVergent. Nos valeurs Make it easy for others. Nous simplifions le complexe et agissons avec les meilleures intentions. Own the outcome. Nous sommes proactifs, rapides et confiants pour faire avancer les choses : le progrès avant la perfection. Rise to the challenge. Nous visons haut et repoussons les limites. Nous restons curieux, apprenons et célébrons nos réussites ensemble. Tell the story. Nous commençons par le « pourquoi ». Nous sommes transparents et partageons nos connaissances pour inspirer les autres. Upvest garantit l’égalité des chances. Nous célébrons la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous. À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. description: „Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter. Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest. Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Deine Mission Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr: Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen. Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt. Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung. Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst. Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark. Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach. Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich. Was du mitbringst Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet. Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen. Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen. Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht. Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl. description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive. 

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on Northern Europe. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and revenue growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.
  • Growing our revenue and share of wallet within your key account list. 
  • Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.
  • Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.
  • Selling solutions to a technical and business audience. 
  • Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base. 
  • History of working with accounts ranging from large multinational enterprise customers to Digital Natives. 
  • Demonstrated success by achieving quota on a consistent basis.
  • Track record of Account Management experience and a solid understanding of how to cross and upsell solutions within a mature customer base. 
  • A solid understanding of financial reporting within a direct customer base - Revenue tracking

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience.
  • Experience and understanding of working in the communications market is preferable.  Have sold or worked with Messaging, Voice Calling, Email, Account Security Verification.  Or have prior experience in a traditional telecommunications environment/business.

Location

The position will  be remotely based in the UK.

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25%  travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

description: About DataSnipper Audit is the bedrock of the global economy. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI. More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running. Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution. The Role Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with. Actief bijdragen aan de inrichting, validatie en optimalisatie van ERP-systemen en supply chain-processen. Ondersteunen van processen rondom traceability, certificering en mass balancing. Initiëren en leiden van verbeteringen op het gebied van planning, systemen en werkwijzen. Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe planningsvraagstukken tijdens operational readiness en de opstart van de fabriek. Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven. Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie. Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing. description: Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact. The challenge The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards. Your responsibilities include: Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control. System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS. Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments. Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations. Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements. Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments. Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Required Skills and Competencies: Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control. Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS. Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications. Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments. Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities. Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements. Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues Education and Experience: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field. Relevant experience in intelligent building management solutions, industrial automation, and safety-critical systems. This role combines technological innovation with safety-critical applications. As a System Architect, you will develop integrated solutions that maximize comfort, safety, efficiency, and sustainability in both buildings and industrial processes. We offer A position of 32-40 hours per week with a salary to match. Challenging projects for leading clients in the Netherlands and internationally. A work environment in which innovation and sustainability are put into practice daily. Attention to your own development and vitality with ample training and development opportunities, bicycle and sports arrangements, flexible working hours, 33 vacation days and the possibility of purchasing additional days. Hybrid working, where you have the opportunity to alternate between working from home and the office. A team where cooperation and collegiality are priority, and where we interact informally. Sustainability is in our genes. This is expressed, for example, in a mobility policy where health and sustainability are most important. Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport. About Deerns As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. About WPP

WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.

About the Role

The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.

Why This Role Matters

WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.

What You’ll Do

Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability

  • Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.
  • Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.
  • Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.
  • Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.
  • Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.

Enable strategic workforce planning

  • Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.
  • Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.
  • Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.
  • Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.

Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support

  • Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.
  • Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.
  • Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.

Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions

  • Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.
  • Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.
  • Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.
  • Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.

Scale tools, capability and adoption

  • Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.
  • Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.
  • Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.
  • Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.
  • Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.
  • Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.
  • Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.
  • Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.
  • AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.
  • Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.
  • A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.
  • Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.
  • Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.
  • Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.
  • A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.
  • Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.
  • Stronger adoption of workforce insight by business and People & Culture leaders, with greater confidence in what the data can and cannot support.
  • A focused, capable India-based team that delivers consistent reporting while building higher-value workforce intelligence and decision-support capability.

title: Full Stack AI Engineer Associate Manager

description: About Accenture Data & AI The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society is underway. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their businesses with data and AI — backed by a $3 billion investment and a commitment to industry-defining work. With over 45,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture's Data & AI organization brings together Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and a Power Ecosystem to deliver outcomes at the frontier of what is possible. About the Role The Full Stack AI Consultant (Developer) is a hands-on engineer at the core of Accenture's agentic AI delivery capability. This role is for those who build things — full stack applications, agentic workflows, knowledge pipelines, and tool integrations — and who want to do that work at the frontier of enterprise AI. Consultants work within delivery teams, turning business requirements into production-grade agentic AI solutions under the guidance of technical leads and managers. The expectation is active, daily engineering: writing code, building agents, implementing MCP servers, designing knowledge pipelines, and maintaining the DevOps and AgentOps practices that keep production systems running. Consultants on this team are also expected to invest continuously in learning — agentic AI is evolving rapidly, and staying current is a professional responsibility, not optional. Position Responsibilities Full Stack Application Development Design and build full stack agentic AI applications — Python backends, REST and event-driven APIs, and React or equivalent frontends — to production engineering standards. Implement agentic application UX: streaming responses, intermediate output display, reasoning transparency, and error and escalation interfaces for end users. Translate business requirements into technical specifications; work with managers and clients to clarify scope, surface ambiguities, and deliver against agreed outcomes. Agentic AI Development Build and configure agents using established orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent): harness setup, persona and instruction loading, tool binding, memory configuration, and lifecycle management. Implement reasoning patterns (ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute) appropriate to each agent use case; design and version prompt architecture including system prompts, few-shot examples, and structured output schemas. Build multi-agent workflows — defining agent roles, A2A handoff contracts, shared state schemas, and escalation paths — under architectural guidance from technical leads. MCP, Tools, Skills, and Workflows Design, build, and maintain MCP servers connecting agents to enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms — with robust schema design, error handling, idempotency, and retry logic. Translate business processes into agent-executable skills, structured instructions, and reusable workflows — bridging the gap between business requirements and agent implementation. Implement context engineering pipelines, memory architectures (episodic, working, long-term), and LLM gateway configuration to support reliable, cost-efficient agent operation. Knowledge Layer Implementation Build RAG pipelines: document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector store indexing, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and quality evaluation. Implement Text-to-SQL capabilities — schema grounding, query generation, validation, and safe execution against enterprise databases. Integrate Elasticsearch as a retrieval backend; build knowledge graph components and ontology-driven query layers where required by the use case. DevOps, AgentOps, and Quality Maintain CI/CD pipelines for agent code, prompt changes, and infrastructure — including automated evaluation gates and deployment strategies across environments. Instrument agentic systems with production observability: distributed tracing, token cost tracking, latency profiling, failure logging, and drift detection. Build agent testing suites: unit tests with mocked tools, multi-agent integration tests, and simulation environments; implement guardrails, PII redaction, and audit trail logging. Manage versioned agent and asset registries — agents, tools, skills, prompts, and workflows — with controlled promotion across development, staging, and production. Continuous Learning and Innovation Maintain active, current knowledge of agentic AI frameworks, tooling, and research — testing new approaches and bringing relevant innovations into the team's engineering practice. Contribute to internal knowledge sharing: documenting patterns, building reusable accelerators, and supporting capability development within the team. Core Requirements 3+ years of full stack software engineering in production — Python backend and a frontend framework (React, Angular, or Node.js). 3+ years building and deploying LLM-based applications — prompt engineering, RAG, tool integration, or agent development. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks — agents, tools, orchestration — in project or production environments. 3+ years experience in classical AI/ML, data engineering, or analytics — integrating models or data pipelines into software applications. Experience with classical software engineering disciplines: CI/CD, TDD, version control, code review, and automated testing. 2+ years cloud-native development on AWS, Azure, or GCP — containerised workloads, managed services, and infrastructure as code. Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and delivering against them. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree is highly valued. Additional Skills Hands-on experience building agents with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent frameworks. Experience building MCP servers or tool integration layers for LLM applications. Experience implementing RAG pipelines — ingestion, retrieval, re-ranking, and quality evaluation. Exposure to Text-to-SQL, knowledge graphs, or Elasticsearch for enterprise knowledge retrieval. Experience with DevOps/AgentOps/LLMOps tooling and CI/CD for AI systems. Experience with classical AI/ML model integration — prediction APIs, model serving, feature pipelines. Active engagement with the agentic AI community — open source contributions, side projects, or published learning. Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex). description: Project Role : Large Language Model Architect Project Role Description : Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data. Must have skills : Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Virtual Agents Good to have skills : NA Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: We are looking for an experienced Ontology Modeler to join Context & Ontology, the team responsible for building the enterprise knowledge foundation that powers AI agents across the platform. In this role, you will work closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across Finance, Legal, Procurement, HR, and other enterprise functions to capture business knowledge and translate it into structured, reusable ontology models. As an Ontology Modeler, you will bridge the gap between business and technology by creating standardized semantic models that enable AI systems to consistently understand enterprise concepts, relationships, and business rules. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Data Engineering Good to have skills : Amazon Web Services (AWS) Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS). The role leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, data pipelines, and cloud-native engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value. Key Responsibilities Engineer AWS-based knowledge engineering solutions using services such as Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Redshift, Athena, OpenSearch, Bedrock, SageMaker, IAM, Step Functions, APIs, and monitoring/security services. Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on AWS while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope. Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly. Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered data and AI offerings. Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions. Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities. Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems. Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods. Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms. Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program. Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client-facing, and cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building AWS-based knowledge engineering solutions with Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Redshift, Athena, OpenSearch, Bedrock, SageMaker, IAM, Step Functions, and cloud-native APIs/monitoring services. Strong Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. Ability to design and implement scalable graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services. Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms, with AWS specialization and exposure to Azure or GCP in multi-cloud environments. AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, Machine Learning/AI Specialty, or related credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge-driven use cases. External client-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre-sales exposure. Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline broad exposure to diverse ML techniques and agentic systems. description: Project Role : Knowledge Engineer Project Role Description : Design and structure knowledge frameworks that enable AI systems to reason and make informed decisions. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : AWS BigData Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering for a strong individual contributor who helps build scalable Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI-enabled data solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role you will work hands-on across the knowledge graph lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, implementation, integration, and deployment. The role applies current methodologies, generative AI, LLM, multimodal, graph, search, and semantic techniques to practical business problems while collaborating with users, use case representatives, engineers, architects, UI designers, and delivery teams. The role must include industry experience or project exposure in domains such as banking, insurance, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences. Key Responsibilities Build AWS-based knowledge engineering components using Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, CloudWatch, APIs, and other relevant AWS services. Implement graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic data products, vector and search integrations, LLM grounding layers, and governed access patterns on AWS. Build Knowledge Graph components that contribute to transforming a client's data architecture. Design, develop, configure, test, and implement AI and semantic solutions that integrate clearly with the broader enterprise system. Work alongside project teams, delivery leads, engineers, architects, users, use case representatives, and UI designers to deliver assigned components of an end-to-end solution. Build solid working relationships with client counterparts on the workstream and communicate implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and technical findings clearly. Help assemble supporting evidence for recommended semantic layer solutions, including design rationale, implementation notes, validation inputs, data quality observations, and test outcomes. Support sales, solutioning, demos, accelerators, or reusable assets when called upon by providing technical inputs or implementation examples. Design, evaluate, maintain, and deploy ontologies, schemas, mappings, graph data models, metadata structures, validation rules, and knowledge graph components as needed. Keep developing skills in cutting-edge Data and AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, generative AI, LLMs, multimodal models, semantic search, graph RAG, and knowledge graph approaches. Share learnings with the team and help junior engineers understand practical development patterns, engineering standards, and knowledge graph implementation practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 2 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 2 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 2 years designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical contexts. Minimum 1 year of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementation for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 2 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. No leadership or commercial ownership requirement at this band team lead exposure is good to have. Ability to work hands-on as a strong individual contributor while collaborating across project teams and delivery workstreams. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building AWS-enabled knowledge engineering solutions with Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, CloudWatch, APIs, and cloud-native data/AI services. 2+ years of Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, APIs, and ETL pipeline development. Practical experience with NLP and/or search techniques, prompt engineering, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, semantic search, and enterprise-scale AI application patterns. Ability to formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Knowledge Graph solution components. Industry experience applying AWS-enabled knowledge engineering solutions in banking, insurance, healthcare, retail, communications, manufacturing, energy, public services, life sciences, or another relevant domain. Ability to build AWS-based components for semantic layer, ontology, graph, vector search, search, retrieval, and LLM grounding use cases. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms, with AWS specialization and exposure to Azure or GCP in multi-cloud environments. AWS certification or hands-on project experience in AWS data, AI/ML, solution architecture, or cloud engineering. Team lead exposure or readiness to guide junior engineers on project tasks. External client-facing consulting experience, including working with client stakeholders, delivery teams, or solutioning teams. Broad experience in diverse ML techniques, graph RAG, agentic systems, semantic search, entity resolution, multimodal models, explainable AI, and responsible AI practices. Experience building reusable code components, implementation templates, design notes, demos, proof-of-concept assets, runbooks, or enablement material. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.
